While every woman who has worked with him in the last six years hates his guts.

A masterful gambit, I can't wait to see how this plays with New Yorkers.

Wayfarer and Justin Baldoni caught in another lie...

Originally they argued Jones was part of a scheme with Lively to obtain Abel's phone.

Turns out no, Jones' lawyers were already trading blows with Wayfarer, August 14th 2024, a week before Abel was terminated. 

Wayfarer used Nathan to plant a Daily Mail story, blamed Jones for it, then prevented Jones clearing her name with Sony.

12. A fake report based on faked "generated synthetic" data is entirely what one would expect from the absolute fraud that is Justin Baldoni...

I just didn't think his team would be so absolutely blatant about it. The hearing about this on Friday will be interesting.

11. Which showed, when defending her limited 44,000 item data set as being consistent with "academic research standards" by citing to a paper with the entirely wrong title and used a data set of 541 million items.

10. Continuing a concerning pattern. When Alexander was asked to name journals in her field she could only name two. 

Nor could she explain how she found the papers she cited given she doesn't read or know the journals they are sourced from.

9. When this was pointed out, Alexander didn't fix the analysis based on the data she provided...

... instead Wayfarer's expert provided an entirely new data set that matched the already performed analysis.

8. Out of the 110 data points used in Alexander's expert report, only 2 were accurate, <2%.

The totals are correct, what happened is 11,000 items (1/4 of the entire data set) from December 2024 were incorrectly assigned and spread out to other months.

7. The numbers used also bare no relation to the actual data set. Lively's team compared what was claimed (Meta input) to the 44,000 social media items (data set)

For August, it was claimed there were 1,175 Instagram items... in reality there were only 2.

6. Meaning Alexander's entire opinion is a conclusion based on pre-generated synthetic (fake) data.

Which is insane Wayfarer's expert did this, even more so THAT THEY LEFT THIS IN THE FILES

#stitch with @Jack Mac  Maxxing is the trend of obsessively optimizing an aspect of your life in order to be more successful. Yet the entire enterprise is fraught with denial, over confidence and emotional fragility. Rather than work to resolve any of the issues, it simple papers over insecurities and relies on a projective performance of strength. One that inevitably comes crashing down.  #toxicmasculinity #misogyny #relationshipadvice #looksmaxxingtips

Men are simple, they just want transactional relationships. Which sounds great until they find that they are in a transactional relationship. Maybe it's time to adapt, and stop expecting the road to failure will lead somewhere new. Maybe, just maybe, there's a better route... #misogyny #toxicmasculinity #relationshipadvice #dating #feminism

The problem with the bad advice given to young men is it is often surrounded by more benign advice, giving the illusion of safety. Yet when you scratch the surface, you find it is the same harmful beliefs that send men spiraling into rage, depression and violence.  #misogyny #toxicmasculinity #relationshipadvice #dating #feminism

A Federal Judge has ruled Blake Lively's retaliation claims are heading to trial, without her sexual harassment claims. Because as an independent contractor, the law doesn't protect her from harassment. A ruling that is a blow not just for Lively, but for all the country's 12M independent contractors who just got reminded they can be harassed without consequence. credit to: @Best Ex (Secret)   #blakelively #justinbaldoni #misogyny #feminism #harassment
